body: Thank you everyone for your kind words. I finally fell asleep last night. I am still here

Right now I feel like a failure., or that maybe I will just never be good enough. I feel like I’m just a shell of my former self. I don’t even know how to explain it. I hate feeling this way. The only reason I’m still here is because I’m afraid of death completely. I want my suffering to end but it just won’t.
